name: better-session-view
description: Session manager for large Ableton Live sets.
author: Ryan Gavin

scripts.build: npm run build:ui && npm run build:bridge && npm run build:device
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n bridge,types,lom,ui,bench,devices -c cyan,blue,magenta,green,yellow,red "node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning tools/dev-bridge.ts" "tsc -p bridge/tsconfig.node.json --noEmit --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "tsc -p bridge/tsconfig.v8.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "vite --config ui/vite.config.ts" "vite --config widgets/vite.config.ts" "vite --config ui/vite.bench.config.ts"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p bridge/tsconfig.node.json --noEmit && tsc -p bridge/tsconfig.v8.json --noEmit && tsc -p core/tsconfig.json && tsc -p widgets/tsconfig.json && tsc -p ui/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tools/tsconfig.json && tsc -p visuals/tsconfig.json
scripts.postinstall: cd bridge && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && cd ../visuals && npm install --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build:link
